Validate a Positive Integer

Source: R/s7-validators.R
validate_positive_integer.Rd

Returns an S7 property validator function that requires value to be a single non-NA integer greater than or equal to 1. The returned function returns NULL when valid, otherwise the string "<message>" (defaults to "must be a positive integer").

Usage

validate_positive_integer(message = "must be a positive integer")

Arguments

message

Character scalar; the error string returned when value is invalid. Defaults to "must be a positive integer". Pass a property-name-prefixed string to preserve a previously established error message verbatim.

Value

A function(value) suitable as an S7 property validator.
